svg.text: Rules: at most two shapes · no drawn objects · meaning comes from how the shapes relate · must read at 16px
Each card: the mark, then the same mark at 32px and 16px on light and dark.

foreignObject.div: One solid, one open. What was said, and the space that received it.
A shape and its reply, a step behind. Every report comes back.
A voice, and one curve turned toward it. Someone is listening.
Half spoken, half heard. Neither is whole without the other.
One line that goes out and comes back, carrying the answer.
A frame around one point: this is the place, say it here.
Two people, and the shape their conversation makes between them.
A soft square with a single point: a speech bubble, reduced to nothing but its tail.
A circle with one square corner: the smallest possible thing said.
Two voices turned toward each other, corners meeting.
Two bars, one a step lower: taking turns. Together they suggest an H.
A ring with one voice entering it.
The peacock feather's eye in two shapes: being seen.
The quote mark at its minimum: a pause, then someone speaks.
Two half circles, slightly out of step: a conversation completing.
An open ring that leaves a gap, and the voice that fills it.
